Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave — Launch Trailer — Nintendo Switch 2
The Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave game is available now, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fire-emblem-fortunes-weave-switch-2/

The Heroic Games have begun! 

Command your units across the map and fight to gain the upper hand in strategic, turn-based combat. Between matches, visit locations within the city of Dagsion to prepare for battle by recruiting allies, honing your skills at the training ground, and strengthening your bonds. Or venture out into the surrounding lands to complete quests, gather resources, defeat roaming enemies, and more.

Follow the paths of four Heroes and fight to save the future from ruin in Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave.
